bio: Christopher Michael Jones (born October 13, 1976) is an American politician and the Democratic nominee for Congressional District 02. He was the Democratic Party nominee for governor of Arkansas in the 2022 election. Born in Pine Bluff, Arkansas, he attended Morehouse College and graduate school at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology.
